title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
genre: Historical Romance, Revenge Drama, Secret Identity
tone: Melodramatic, Tense, High Stakes, Aristocratic Vindication
premise: Lady Juliana is abandoned at the altar by her fiancé Gerald and her cruel family in favor of her sister Clarissa. To salvage her dignity, she impulsively agrees to marry a scarred, crippled ex-soldier. Unbeknownst to her and her malicious former family, her humble soldier husband is secretly Alexander, the long-presumed-dead Duke of Ashburn, who is investigating corruption and treachery among the high nobility.

main_characters.name: Lady Juliana
main_characters.description: Dutiful, proud noblewoman betrayed by family

main_characters.name: Alexander (Mysterious Soldier / Duke)
main_characters.description: War-hardened soldier secretly Duke of Ashburn

main_characters.name: Lord Ashcroft
main_characters.description: Juliana's cruel father who disowns her

central_twists.twist: Gerald dumps Juliana at the altar to marry her sister Clarissa.
Juliana takes marriage vows with a mysterious scarred soldier.
Juliana's family formally disowns her and throws her mother's ledger in the mud.
Alexander discovers someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
Alexander officially unmasks himself in full ducal regalia as the rightful Duke of Ashburn, shocking the entire court.
